description.value: Thomas Haas Chocolates is a celebrated artisanal chocolatier and café in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, operated by award-winning pastry chef Thomas Haas. The café offers handcrafted pastries, gourmet croissants and sandwiches, house-made confections, chocolate bars, coffee, and hot chocolate, with both indoor and outdoor seating. Cyclists riding the West Broadway corridor will find this a tempting stop for high-quality baked goods and sweets.
